tier_should.rationale: Comprehensive RCT meta-analysis on MAP reduction with rigorous bias sensitivity; important policy topic. Effects small yet informative; clear classification of interventions. Methods credible; fit for behavioral nutrition/public health journals, though limited novelty/mechanistic insight.

tier_will.rationale: Likely to place in solid field journal; heterogeneity and small effects reduce splash. Credible authorship helps, but limited novelty/mechanistic insight and mixed evidence constrain appeal to top general outlets.
